title_zh: 拓扑条件化共形风险控制：面向通信退化下多无人机强化学习策略的选择性部署
title_en: Topology-Conditional Conformal Risk Control for Selective Deployment of Multi-UAV Reinforcement Learning Policies under Communication Degradation
problem: A high average return does not tell an operator when a frozen multi-UAV policy is likely to violate a mission-risk tolerance under topology degradation or structural shift.
single_core_innovation: finite-sample topology-conditional risk calibration and selective deployment for frozen MARL policies, with explicit risk-coverage control under communication-topology strata

closest_work_boundaries.conformal_policy_evaluation: provides return intervals but does not by itself deliver topology-stratified selective deployment for cooperative UAV policies
closest_work_boundaries.CAMMARL: conformalizes other-agent actions for decision making rather than calibrating mission risk under communication-topology shift
closest_work_boundaries.risk_averse_calibration: supplies general decision-theoretic foundations; TC-CRC must contribute the topology-stratified sequential deployment formulation and UAV evidence
closest_work_boundaries.generic_uncertainty_or_abstention: cannot replace finite-sample risk calibration and violation-rate auditing
